verdict.rationale: Cactus does run quantized models: community users ran a fine-tuned Needle 3 at W4A8, the platform offers 2-bit exports, the demo app downloads GGUF models, and HuggingFace models can be converted with the experimental `cactus convert`. Nothing shows it loading the named formats (FP8, INT4, GPTQ, AWQ) directly, and the GGUF models crashed the demo app on selection. Missing for 10: documented support for loading FP8/GPTQ/AWQ/INT4 checkpoints, a list of supported quantization formats, non-experimental conversion of third-party quantized models.
